claims.text: Autonomous drone delivery of medical supplies and small parcels over short distances, with a working prototype and a handful of demonstration flights.
Risks recorded by the fund: Regulatory permission for commercial operations was uncertain on a multi-year horizon. No signed customer. Liability and insurance unaddressed. Weak commercial co-founder.

Partner assessment of founders from the meeting: Dr. Meera Kapoor, an aerospace PhD with a strong research record, and an operations co-founder who joined recently. Technically excellent and deeply convincing on the flight systems. She had less to say about who the paying customer was, who bore liability for a failed delivery, and how regulators would permit routine beyond-visual-line-of-sight operation. She viewed those as 'solved once the tech works'.
